[[File:Boushh.png|thumb|200px|Boushh, a native speaker of Ubese]]
'''Ubese''' was the native [[Language/Legends|language]] of the [[Ubese/Legends|Ubese]], a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Near-Human]]s that hailed from [[Ubertica]], [[Uba III]] and [[Uba IV/Legends|Uba IV]].<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> It was a metallic language, well-adapted to the rarefied atmosphere of the home planet from which the nomadic Ubese came.<ref name="ROJN">''[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' novel]]''</ref>

Ubese vocal cords could not produce sound above raspy whispers, making them difficult to understand when their voices weren't amplified. The Ubese also developed a sign language, [[Ubeninal]], as an alternative to communicate with other Ubese. Ubeninal had no written form. Most Ubese were fluent in Ubese language, Ubeninal and [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], the common language of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], although they were only literate in their own language. Ubese rarely chose to speak Basic.<ref name="UAA" />

When [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] disguised herself as the Ubese [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] named [[Boushh/Legends|Boushh]] and brought [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]], the Hutt himself temporarily left aside his principle of only speaking [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]]. He answered in Ubese, although it was stilted and slow. Realizing that his skills in the Ubese language were not sufficient to sustain a full conversation, Jabba eventually turned to his [[talkdroid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] to serve as an interpreter.<ref name="ROJN" />

==Known words and phrases==
*''Yatay yatay yatoh'' - "I have come for the bounty on this Wookiee."<ref name="SWI67">{{InsiderCite|67|The Ultimate Return of the Jedi Insider's Guide|The Ultimate ''Return of the Jedi'' Insider's Guide}}</ref>
*''Yo czhal'' - A phrase enabling someone to be frisked.<ref name="bounty" />
*''Yo tzak sze Chorh-dha?'' - A phrase inquiring about [[Chorh-dha]], when he didn't show up as expected.<ref name="bounty">{{WEGCite|story=Bounty's Due|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>
*''Yrak pootzck'' - A phrase implying cowardice and impure parentage.<ref name="UAA" />
*''Zeebuss'' - "I agree."<ref name="ROJN" />
